column3: Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “He is” before “gracious.”
“Good [is] a man” is rendered “It is well with the man,” and “he maintains his affairs with justice” as “He will maintain his cause in judgment.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the righteous will be for an everlasting memory” is rendered “will be remembered forever.”
NASB adds “with satisfaction” to “looks … on his adversaries.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he scatters, he gives” is rendered “He has given freely.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “it,” and “be angry” is rendered “be vexed.”
